notes.title: 3 days until Kickstarter!
notes.content:
We'll launch our Kickstarter campaign on May 19th 💚✨

[list]
[*]During our pre-campaign, we created a survey to know more about the rewards you could enjoy. With Zelyphia, our illustrator, we worked hard to propose charming physical rewards, and we can't wait to reveal them to you 😊
[*]Partnerships have been formed with several streamers to broadcast the demo on Twitch and YouTube.
[*] We'll launch a Discord server for easy communication with backers.
[*]Funding raised by Kickstarter will go to complete the CGs creation, and the stretch goals aim to bring new content to the game!
[/list]
Take part in the journey! [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/talestrike/ecosphere-visual-novel]Follow the campaign now[/url][/b] and be ready to bring this universe to life with us! 🚀

notes.title: Progress of the extended Demo
notes.content:
We're currently working on the extended Demo of Ecosphere, which we expect to launch in [b]January 2025[/b]. Here's what you'll be able to expect:

[list]
[*] First hour of the game
[*] Meeting with three potential love interests and the last one will be kept secret ;)
[*] 6 Computer graphics
[*] A new home screen
[*] 8 original audio tracks, loopable for added immersion
[/list]
A [b]new trailer[/b] is also in preparation to introduce you to this project, which the team is working hard to bring to fruition ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388138/5b96d626c8a293544ac147e914fa728ad49d7179.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo update 1.5
notes.content:
We have made some corrections to Ecosphere - Demo and the full game, currently in development :
[list]
[*] New font for the textbox
[*] New version of QTE sequences: the buttons will be empty in transparency, and you'll have to hover over them with your cursor to discover the heroine's possible actions. Act before it's too late!
[*] A single color code (the green) for choices and QTE, for greater consistency
[*] The Steam page screenshots now show you the four love interests !
[/list]

notes.title: Storyteller's Festival & Demo available
notes.content:
We're delighted to announce that Ecosphere has been selected to take part in the Storyteller's Festival! To mark the occasion, we've released a demo to show you a ten-minute sequence of gameplay with the essential features:

[h3]Impact assessment[/h3]

Your choices will have an impact on the universe. First of all, your decisions will shape the heroine's personality: boldness, prudence, or diplomacy, influencing your relationships with the two love interests. For example, Leily is attracted to bold girls but dislikes diplomatic behavior... A reputation system will also help you manage your relationships with NPCs.

[h3]Explore mode[/h3]

Combining both Point & Click and Drag & Drop mechanics, you can interact with the scenery to find clues and deepen the game's lore.

[h3]QTE sequences[/h3]

A dynamic choice system lets you manage action scenes as you wish. But beware: some actions are more relevant than others... Success will depend on how well you analyze the context and your environment!

We hope you enjoy this demo! Don't hesitate to share your feedback with us on social networks - it'll be a great help to us as we continue development!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44388138/c678be27e730c427d142c7c120e85636a545c6f8.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo coming soon
notes.content:
A lot news since the summer, and we're moving ahead with the production of Ecosphere: [b]a demo is coming soon![/b] It will reveal a short sequence of the game, and you'll meet the heroine, Arane Kross, as well as her childhood friend, Zael Collin. Unless things are more ambiguous?

If you've played the Prologue, fear not! Leily Stirner, the Pirate Princess, will still be with us... For better or for worse! We hope to release the demo by the end of January 2024.

A [b]composer / sound designer[/b] specializing in orchestral and epic music is about to join the team. Gone are the days of royalty-free music; from now on, Ecosphere will be entitled to original music and a unique soundscape! A new version of the trailer soundtrack will be available soon.

We would also like to thank the [b]region Hauts-de-France[/b] for its support, which will finance a large part of the artistic direction and follow us throughout the project.

notes.title: Ecosphere - Prologue is available
notes.content:
A prologue is available to introduce the lore and gameplay mechanics. It recounts an event taking place just before the start of the game.

The pitch is as follows: a Pirate Princess must infiltrate a memorial to steal an orb with the power to control nature: Ecosphere. Will you manage to steal the precious loot?

You can find it on its own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2218720/Ecosphere__Prologue/]Steam page[/url] !

In terms of content, you'll find :

• Point & click features and the QTE battle mode
• Original UI
• A Checkpoint system: to avoid having to restart the entire game in the event of a game over. When you enter a new setting, a checkpoint is automatically activated.
• The game is fully accessible to blind people and partially sighted.

Full steam ahead!
